Core Active Vocabulary (5 items):

home — the place where you live. Example: There is a park near my home.
neighborhood — the area around your home. Example: My neighborhood is quiet.
shop — a place where you buy things. Example: The shops are on my street.
park — a public green place in a town. Example: There is a park near my home.
transport — buses, trains and other ways to travel. Example: Public transport is cheap here.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• There is a ... near my home.
• The shops are on ...
• You can go by ...
• It is ten minutes away.
• Welcome to my neighbourhood!
